profile.summary: A nonprofit community organization in the Bay Area that has offered mediation, facilitation, training and restorative justice services since 1983. It works with residents, organizations and schools to help people resolve conflicts and repair relationships. It also offers mediation certification training.

sources.title: Seeds Community Resolution Center - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: The name matches exactly, the Berkeley PO Box matches the agenda city, and the services (mediation, restorative practices, school workshops) fit OUSD's student support category. The About page and ProPublica (EIN 94-3054165, 501(c)(3)) support the profile fields; the ProPublica Oakland address is the IRS record and does not conflict with the Berkeley mailing address. The summary is neutral.
